question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt this `channels.msteams.accounts` and `defaultAccount` contract, with legacy root config as the implicit default account, explicit named-account identity and port requirements, and account-scoped auth/session state?
rationale: This is a public channel configuration and upgrade contract, not a purely mechanical fix; CI and source inspection cannot decide the permanent Teams owner policy.

options.title: Accept the current contract
options.body: Treat the PR's account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.

options.title: Request contract revisions
options.body: Ask for targeted schema, listener, migration, or credential-resolution changes before this becomes public API.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Keep the canonical feature issue open and pause this PR if Teams multi-account support should wait for a shared cross-channel account or listener design.

recommendation.title: Accept the current contract
recommendation.body: Treat the PR's account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.
